reviews.body: Request changes at head 76ff7f05d341e8d55efa3dec4e7bc4c215b271ab. The CLI now simulates poet/editor output, but TRIAL_EVIDENCE.md still explicitly says no fresh world trial, world id, release poem, Docker build log, or regression capture exists. Operator has not produced a trial of this released version. A local smoke runner is not evidence of the HuTian world lifecycle, checkpoint/stop/resume, reader observation, or release gate. Run and record the required trial on the released version, then update the PR with exact world id, release, poem, checks, and diagnosis before final approval.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body:
Request changes at head 88419c2a32266190212b251cad11aba3f12c0d05.

The added CLI smoke runner is not acceptance evidence: TRIAL_EVIDENCE.md explicitly says no fresh world trial, world id, release poem, Docker build log, or regression capture exists. Operator confirms world/result still has only v1 and will trial this only after a release.

Also, the CLI implementation writes the input verbatim to poem.md; it does not exercise poet/editor/reader contracts, editor approval, checkpoint/stop/resume, or the release gate. Supply a corrected released version and operator's complete trial record with the required first-snow task, lifecycle, editor-approved release, world id, poem, and checks before requesting final approval.

reviews.body: Request changes at head 08e65be690eca42951fc07058d7b9072c9165afe. The package delivery and hutian/delivery status are present, and the PR is mergeable, but final acceptance requires evidence that this released version was installed and reached its release in a fresh trial. Operator#3 remains open with trial-machine DNS/SSH failure, and there is no trial world id, regression/Docker output, released poem, or updated diagnosis to inspect. Restore trial-machine access, run the required task under the specified worker/budget, preserve the records, then update this PR with the exact trial evidence. Do not merge into final until that evidence exists.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body:
Request changes at head 890b71201cd6a2c2beec17b0925eee4666f1f3b4.

Open findings:
1. The delivered tree is contract-only: README.md and STATUS.md explicitly say executable implementation is pending the host schema, so it cannot satisfy the objective's installable/runnable domain requirement. Add the real package integration against DEV.md/reference conventions and verify `pip install .`, the `poemworld` command, and the hutian.definitions entry point.
2. Required repository integration is absent from this PR: install.sh, CI workflow registration, and per-domain regression checks. Add them and run the checks where Docker is available.
3. The objective requires system and worker images; this PR contains only one generic Dockerfile and no wired poet/editor/reader images or runtime organization integration. Add the required images and wiring.
4. The operator trial is still blocked by trial-machine SSH/DNS failure (operator#3), so there is no fresh install, image build, regression run, or PoemWorld release evidence. Keep the release gate closed until operator records a successful trial with world id, release, and poem.

The PR is mergeable and hutian/delivery is green, but that status does not replace the missing delivery and trial evidence.
